notes_zh:
- **修复** 一次性复制上千个文件时，快捷面板 / 主窗口预览该条记录会卡死数秒的问题（文件列表改为按需渲染，图标与统计信息改为缓存 / 异步计算）
- **修复** 快捷面板切换分类再切回来后，选中项停留在中途分类自动选中的条目上的问题；现在每次切换分类都选中该分类的第一条
notes_en:
- **Fix** Selecting a clip with thousands of copied files no longer freezes the quick panel / main window preview (file list now renders lazily; icons and stats are cached / computed asynchronously)
- **Fix** Switching category tabs back and forth no longer leaves a stale selection carried over from the intermediate tab; each switch now selects the first item of that category

beta.notes_zh:
- **新增** 短信验证码自动提取：iPhone 开启「短信转发」到 Mac 后，收到验证码短信会自动提取验证码、复制到剪贴板并发送通知，任意输入框直接 ⌘V 粘贴。默认关闭，可在 设置 → 预览与识别 中开启（需授权完全磁盘访问权限）
- **新增** 验证码条目在列表中带 OTP 角标，预览区以验证码格子 + 短信原文卡片展示
- **修复** 手机号/邮箱类型的历史条目无法在「文本」分类中筛选到的问题
beta.notes_en:
- **New** Automatic SMS verification codes: with iPhone Text Message Forwarding enabled, incoming codes are extracted, copied to the clipboard and announced via notification — just ⌘V anywhere. Off by default; enable it in Settings → Preview & Recognition (requires Full Disk Access)
- **New** Verification-code clips get an OTP badge in lists and a dedicated preview showing the code cells alongside the original message
- **Fix** Phone/email-type clips were missing from the Text category filter
